core_principles: Product is Hero: Massive imagery, minimal text.
Micro-Interactions: Every hover, click, and scroll has feedback.
Negative Space: 3x standard padding to create luxury feel.
Asymmetry: Broken grids to avoid 'template' look.

grid_system.product_listing: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-x-8 gap-y-12

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground h-12 px-8 rounded-full font-medium hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-200 shadow-lg
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground h-12 px-8 rounded-full font-medium hover:bg-secondary/80 transition-colors
buttons.outline: border-2 border-primary text-primary h-12 px-8 rounded-full font-medium hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground transition-all

cards.feature: bg-zinc-50 p-8 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-100 hover:border-zinc-200 transition-colors

inputs.default: h-12 bg-transparent border-b-2 border-zinc-200 rounded-none px-0 focus:border-black transition-colors placeholder:text-zinc-400

usage.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
usage.stagger_children: variants={{ hidden: { opacity: 0 }, show: { opacity: 1, transition: { staggerChildren: 0.1 } } }}

asset_instructions.icons: Use lucide-react for all UI icons (shopping-bag, search, menu, user).
asset_instructions.logo: Use text logo 'LUXE.' in Syne font, ExtraBold, tracking-tighter.

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds, use solid colors or subtle noise textures.
Avoid centering text unless absolutely necessary for balance.
Use generous padding (py-24, py-32) between sections.
Ensure all interactive elements have a hover state.
Use data-testid attributes for all clickable elements.
Do not use generic 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Syne'.
Images must have 'object-cover' and be wrapped in overflow-hidden containers for zoom effects.

component_instructions.header: Sticky, glassmorphism effect (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/70). Logo left, Nav center, Actions right.
component_instructions.hero: Full height (min-h-screen) or large (min-h-[80vh]). Split layout or full background image with overlay.
component_instructions.product_card: Minimalist. Image takes 80% of height. Title and price below. No visible button until hover (or subtle icon button).
component_instructions.footer: Large typographic footer. 'Syne' font for big links. Multi-column layout for links.
